gen-dafont-quantum-gf-noticia-text: Clean, loose and tech-minded, Quantum keeps its ascenders short and its line weight unvarying. Noticia Text brings a dignified serif voice, with wide entrances into its curves and lowercase bodies that fill most of the height.
gen-dafont-quantum-mulish: Quantum spaces its letters loosely, with plenty of breathing room. Mulish carries the text with a large x-height and open horseshoe-shaped apertures, so paragraphs move along smoothly, modern and approachable.
gen-dafont-quantum-roboto-slab: Roboto Slab gives the text a precise, structured slab-serif backbone. Quantum above it is a plain stripe of constant ink, loose and tech-clean, so the page moves from light display to dense, open-throated reading.
gen-dafont-redux-bitter: Bitter reads sturdy and grounded, its slab-serif lowercase large with s shapes you can see right through. Redux heads it with wide spacing and a soft contrast, so extended text feels steady and never stark.
gen-dafont-redux-gf-glegoo: Refined and editorial, Glegoo is a serif with big counters. Redux above is wide-set and geometric, with thin strokes not far from thick, while the body's wide-mouthed curves keep lots of text moving smoothly.
gen-dafont-redux-gf-kadwa: Classic and editorial, Kadwa is a serif with open-ended curves and a larger-than-usual x-height, while Redux goes wide and geometric. Its body size can stay modest, since the x-height does the work.
gen-dafont-redux-gf-piazzolla: Wide-set and geometric, Redux leads with reed-pen curves. Piazzolla partners it as a refined serif, lowercase nearly matching the capitals and its e opened like a pried clasp, so the two sit together comfortably.
gen-dafont-redux-rubik: Wide-set and geometric, Redux carries the tempered contrast of a lightly flexed spring wire, with enlarged lowercase letters. Rubik keeps its round letters soft and clear in running text.
gen-dafont-sf-wonder-comic-gf-suwannaphu: Dense and tall: SF Wonder Comic leaves its bowls open on one side. Suwannaphum, a dignified serif with a c like a bent paperclip and a high x-height, can stay modest in size.
gen-dafont-sf-wonder-comic-manrope: Tall and dense in the middle, SF Wonder Comic leaves its bowls unfinished, with stems barely heavier than their arms. Manrope brings a bright, open-mouthed sans line that holds one width.
